title: ETL Job Runbook — Fill-in Template, Health Checks and Airflow Cheatsheet
title_es: Runbook de Job ETL — Plantilla rellenable, health checks y chuleta de Airflow
description: Fill-in ETL job runbook template, an executable pre-run health-check script (Airflow, API, bucket, warehouse, dbt), a verified Airflow 2.x CLI cheat sheet with removed commands, a dbt schema.yml with the quality-gate tests, and a game-day drill checklist.
description_es: Plantilla rellenable de runbook de job ETL, script ejecutable de health checks pre-corrida (Airflow, API, bucket, warehouse, dbt), chuleta verificada de la CLI de Airflow 2.x con los comandos eliminados, un schema.yml de dbt con los tests del quality gate y un checklist de simulacro game day.
